run_object_detection_on_images: run object detection on input images using Detectron2 with a config file and save visualized outputs
run_object_detection_on_video: run object detection on a video file using Detectron2 and save the annotated video output
run_object_detection_on_webcam: run real-time object detection from a webcam feed using Detectron2 and display results in an OpenCV window
setup_detectron2_config: setup a Detectron2 configuration from a YAML config file with custom confidence threshold and command-line options
test_opencv_video_codec: test whether a given OpenCV video codec and file extension are supported on the current system
